content:
Apple Upgrade is a brand-new leasing program announced today, allowing you to get Apple products through a low monthly fee subscription. Below are the prices for each eligible product under Apple Upgrade.

iPhone

The following are the current prices for each iPhone model under a 24-month Apple Upgrade lease plan:

  • iPhone 17 Pro：US$31.99 per month
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max：US$34.99 per month
  • iPhone Air：US$28.99 per month
  • iPhone 17：US$22.99 per month
  • iPhone 17e：US$17.99 per month

The above are base model prices; you may choose higher storage capacity versions at a slightly higher price.

If you prefer a 12-month plan, Apple also offers one, but the monthly fee will be higher.

iPad

The following are the prices for iPad under a 36-month Apple Upgrade lease plan:

  • iPad Air 11-inch：US$15.99 per month
  • iPad Air 13-inch：US$19.99 per month
  • iPad Pro 11-inch：US$24.99 per month
  • iPad Pro 13-inch：US$30.99 per month
  • iPad mini：US$11.99 per month

Similarly, the above are base model prices, with upgraded specifications requiring an additional fee. If you wish to shorten the lease term, you may also choose a 24-month plan, but the monthly fee will increase accordingly.

Mac

The following are the prices for Mac under a 36-month Apple Upgrade lease plan:

  • MacBook Air 13-inch：US$24.99 per month
  • MacBook Air 15-inch：US$28.99 per month
  • MacBook Pro 14-inch：US$38.99 per month
  • MacBook Pro 16-inch：US$57.99 per month
  • iMac：US$28.99 per month
  • Mac Studio：US$48.99 per month

For upgraded models with higher memory, storage, or other configuration options, the monthly fee will increase accordingly.

Apple Watch

The following are the prices for Apple Watch under a 24-month Apple Upgrade lease plan:

  • Apple Watch Series 11 (42mm)：US$11.99 per month
  • Apple Watch Series 11 (46mm)：US$12.85 per month
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3：US$24.99 per month

You may also choose to lease Apple Watch models for 12 months, but the monthly fee will be higher.

For complete information about Apple Upgrade, please visit Apple's official website.

Would you consider using Apple Upgrade to purchase future Apple products? Why or why not? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
